title: JSON string scanning and installed reads clear their CodeQL alerts
summary: The strict JSON parser in @inventarch/db and the resource decoder in @inventarch/workspace-runtime find the end of a string token with one left-to-right scan of the JSON string grammar instead of a regular expression CodeQL flags as polynomial. The resource decoder collects each object's members in a Map and defines them on a null-prototype object instead of assigning by key; every input decodes, or is refused, exactly as before. installedImplementationDigest refuses a nonregular entry without opening it and reads each code file through the descriptor whose size it bounded, so a file that grows or is swapped while it is read is refused with IA-CORPUS-DENIED instead of hashed. Valid installed code digests as before.
